name: Titania, Nature's Force
oracle_text:
You may play Forests from your graveyard.
Whenever a Forest you control enters, create a 5/3 green Elemental creature token.
Whenever an Elemental you control dies, you may mill three cards.
blocked_sentences: You may play Forests from your graveyard.

needs.what: a land-filter on the player-wide play_lands_from_graveyard static (e.g. an affects_cards selector with subtypes: ["Forest"]) so the land drop offers only matching lands from the graveyard; still one land drop per turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: play_lands_from_graveyard is a yes/no permission (player_statics.player_plays_lands_from_graveyard), and legality._land_actions then offers every land in the graveyard; it cannot be narrowed by land subtype, so using it would let Titania play Plains, Islands and nonbasic lands from the graveyard too. cast_from_graveyard takes an affects_spells filter but covers spells only, never a land play
